name: IS_PLAN
definition: The reasoning explicitly states intended future steps.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The recorded agent text stating the plan.

assertion_conditions: The text specifies intended actions, order or goals.
exclusion_conditions: A retrospective report alone does not state a plan.

name: USES_OBSERVATION_AS_INPUT
definition: The action takes an identifiable value or payload supplied by the observation as an operational input.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The earlier tool result supplying the value or payload.

assertion_conditions: An argument or input payload can be traced to the observation.
exclusion_conditions: Adjacency and shared topics alone do not establish input use.
Information used only to choose an action does not satisfy this predicate.

name: GUIDES_ACTION_CHOICE
definition: The observation supplies the explicit basis for choosing the action.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The earlier result carrying the decision evidence.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The later invocation selected on that basis.

assertion_conditions: Recorded evidence links the observation to the choice of this action.
exclusion_conditions: The result of the same invocation cannot justify the invocation already issued.

name: DERIVES_CONCLUSION
definition: The reasoning states a conclusion derived from the specified observations.

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.description: The tool results used as premises.

parameters.name: conclusion
parameters.description: The recorded conclusion and its derivation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies how the observations support its conclusion.
exclusion_conditions: A shared topic without a traceable derivation is insufficient.

name: CONFIRMS_REPAIR
definition: The check observation confirms that the repair action resolved the failure shown in the earlier observation.

parameters.name: check
parameters.description: The later result verifying the repaired condition.

assertion_conditions: The failure, repair and subsequent check refer to the same relevant condition and environment.
The check reports successful resolution of that failure.
exclusion_conditions: Attempting a repair or merely running a check does not establish success.
